subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir manifested tentacles, flew, and teleported to grapple the Pudding King, successfully isolating him from his allies.
source_quote: Zalthir manifested his tentacles and prepared to fly as the Earth Elemental smashed through the ochre jelly barricade. The elemental then hurled Zalthir thirty feet into the throne room, and the dragonborn teleported an additional sixty feet closer to the Pudding King before walking the final forty-five feet to reach him. Zalthir struck the gnomish villain and successfully wrapped his tentacles around him in a grapple.

subject: Pudding King
fact: The Pudding King transformed into an amorphous ooze form to evade capture, but remained grappled by Zalthir, who dragged him fifteen feet south away from his allies.
source_quote: In response to being grappled, the Pudding King transformed into an ooze form, his body becoming a shifting, amorphous mass. Despite the transformation, Zalthir maintained his grip and used his remaining movement to drag the Pudding King fifteen feet south, away from his ooze allies.

subject: Princess Ebonheir
fact: Princess Ebonheir is one of the two ooze henchmen of the Pudding King, present during his monologue in the throne room.
source_quote: Through the ochre jelly, the party observed the Pudding King monologuing to his two ooze henchmen, Princess Ebonheir and Prince Livid.

subject: Prince Livid
fact: Prince Livid is one of the two ooze henchmen of the Pudding King, present during his monologue in the throne room.
source_quote: Through the ochre jelly, the party observed the Pudding King monologuing to his two ooze henchmen, Princess Ebonheir and Prince Livid.

subject: Earth Elemental
fact: The Earth Elemental smashed through the ochre jelly barricade and hurled Zalthir thirty feet into the throne room.
source_quote: The Earth Elemental smashed through the ochre jelly barricade. The elemental then hurled Zalthir thirty feet into the throne room.

subject: Green Slime Patches
fact: Green slime patches cover the ceiling of the throne room and could drop on anyone standing beneath them.
source_quote: The party noted green slime patches on the ceiling throughout the throne room that could drop on anyone standing beneath them.

subject: Pudding King's Alliance
fact: The Pudding King made an alliance with the demon lord Juiblex and seeks to convert Blingdenstone's biomass into ooze biomass by having his creatures consume everyone.
source_quote: The party learned that the Pudding King had made an alliance with the demon lord Juiblex and was trying to convert Blingdenstone's biomass into ooze biomass by having his creatures consume everyone.

subject: Zuggtmoy
fact: Zuggtmoy, the Queen of Rot, believes she can take the Pudding King's kingdom, but Juiblex has promised it to him.
source_quote: He also ranted that Zuggtmoy, the Queen of Rot, thought she could take his kingdom, but Juiblex had promised it to him.

subject: Throne Room
fact: The throne room is the site of the Pudding King's monologue, where green slime patches hang from the ceiling and the final confrontation occurs.
source_quote: Through the ochre jelly, the party observed the Pudding King monologuing to his two ooze henchmen... The party noted green slime patches on the ceiling throughout the throne room...

subject: Blingdenstone
fact: Blingdenstone is the target of the Pudding King’s biomass conversion scheme, whose population is being consumed by oozes.
source_quote: The party learned that the Pudding King had made an alliance with the demon lord Juiblex and was trying to convert Blingdenstone's biomass into ooze biomass by having his creatures consume everyone.

subject: attack on the Pudding King
fact: The main distraction force began their attack, allowing Zalthir to close in and grapple the Pudding King.
source_quote: The signal was sent, and the main distraction force began their attack.

subject: plan for the captured Pudding King
fact: The party has not established a clear plan beyond the initial snatch-and-grab for what to do with the Pudding King once captured.
source_quote: They debated what to do with the King once captured, realizing they hadn't established a clear plan beyond the initial snatch-and-grab.

subject: Ooze Form
fact: The Pudding King's ooze form is a shifting, amorphous mass capable of deadly strikes, but he remains grappled and isolated.
source_quote: In response to being grappled, the Pudding King transformed into an ooze form, his body becoming a shifting, amorphous mass... his new form meant he could strike at Zalthir with deadly certainty...

subject: session date
fact: The events described occur during a single session, with no specific calendar date provided.
source_quote: The events unfold as a continuous sequence without reference to a specific calendar date.
